indicator_name: Deposits in depository organisations by currency and holder (legal entities, households), monthly from 1997, million KZT
description: Депозиты в депозитных организациях по валютам и держателям (юридические и физические лица), помесячно с 1997 г., млн тенге
unit: million KZT, stock at the end of the previous month (as at the date)
methodology: NBK page «Депозиты в депозитных организациях» (records JSON), 346 month-end stocks from 1997-12, dated the first day of the next month. Items TOTAL, KZT, FX, each with .LEGAL (non-bank legal entities) and .HOUSEHOLDS, plus transferable / other deposits. TOTAL equals the scalar DEPOSITS_TOTAL. 2026-10-01: total 51 455 187, FX 9 609 118 (18.7 %), legal entities' FX 5 522 360 of 22 850 818 (24.2 %), households' FX 4 086 758 of 28 604 369 (14.3 %); FX share at 2016-01-01 68.8 %. Open-data form 62 is NOT used: its legal-entity rows and total disagree with this page for 2022 and at the latest date.
